result.note: Maritime security incident with a places-in-news angle; tested the location and India's diplomatic response, avoiding casualty counts.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, Indian sailors were reported missing after an attack on the tanker Petro Dolphin. Consider the following statements:
items: Petro Dolphin was waiting for a berth at Sohar Anchorage in Oman when it was struck.
India's Ministry of External Affairs attributed the attacks to a named attacker.
India's embassy in Muscat is coordinating rescue efforts with Omani authorities and ship managers.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the ministry condemned the attacks without identifying an attacker. Two of the 11 Indian sailors aboard Petro Dolphin were missing after a reported drone strike, while a separate projectile strike set fire to Valthera, whose 11 Indian crew were reported safe.
questions.source: The tanker was waiting for a berth at Sohar Anchorage, Oman, and Shipping Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said 9 survivors were rescued.
